facts.text: Cast & Plow is the hotel's marina-front restaurant serving fresh, locally sourced cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Savor fresh, locally-sourced cuisine and handcrafted cocktails at Cast & Plow, our marina-front restaurant.

facts.text: The hotel has a heated saltwater pool.
facts.excerpt: Unwind by the heated saltwater pool, indulge in a personalized Sisley Paris spa treatment

facts.text: Sisley Spa treatments use Sisley products infused with essential oils and extracts.
facts.excerpt: Facials, massages, and body treatments utilize Sisley products, infused with essential oils and extracts

facts.text: The spa has direct pool access and a couple's suite.
facts.excerpt: the luxury spa also features direct pool access and a couple’s suite.

facts.text: The hotel has waterfront lighted tennis courts and lighted pickleball courts on site.
facts.excerpt: Marina Racquet Club manages the two waterfront lighted tennis courts and three lighted pickleball courts.

facts.text: The hotel offers bicycle rentals for riding to nearby Santa Monica, Venice and Manhattan Beaches.
facts.excerpt: We offer bicycle rentals for quick and enjoyable access to nearby Santa Monica, Venice, and Manhattan Beaches.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have Juliet balconies overlooking the marina and a coastal-chic decor.
facts.excerpt: Juliet balconies overlook the marina, layouts include dedicated spaces for work and relaxation and the décor offers a modern take on coastal chic.

facts.text: The Abbot Kinney neighborhood in Venice, with boutiques, restaurants and coffee shops, is one mile from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Discover the Abbot Kinney neighborhood in Venice, just one mile from the hotel, filled with the latest fashion boutiques, restaurants, and coffee shops.

facts.text: Wave Bar + Grill is a seasonal restaurant serving coastal cuisine with marina views.
facts.excerpt: coastal cuisine is featured at the seasonal Wave Bar + Grill.

facts.text: From June through October the hotel has a Butterfly Beach House where guests can see the lifecycle of native butterflies.
facts.excerpt: from June through October, don’t miss the enchanting Butterfly Beach House, where you can witness the lifecycle of native butterflies in a captivating, immersive setting.

facts.text: The hotel can arrange a private yacht excursion or dinner cruise on the marina.
facts.excerpt: Let us arrange a private yacht excursion or dinner cruise on the marina, just steps from our hotel.

facts.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Los Angeles International Airport.
facts.excerpt: No, The Ritz-Carlton, Marina del Rey does not have an airport shuttle to Los Angeles International Airport.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club experience is being reimagined and will debut in July 2027.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Club experience is currently being reimagined and will debut in July 2027.

facts.text: Breakfast at Cast & Plow is available for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Cast & Plow for a fee.
On-site valet parking is available at The Ritz-Carlton, Marina del Rey.
